title: Slider/Range Input
content: Build slider/range input component. Track: horizontal bar representing range. Thumb: draggable handle on track. Value display: show current value above or beside. Min/max: configurable range limits. Step: snap to increment values. Dual thumb: range slider with two handles. Marks: optional tick marks at intervals. Keyboard: arrow keys to adjust value.

variants.simple: Create slider input with draggable thumb and value display.
variants.detailed: Build slider/range input component. Track: horizontal bar representing range. Thumb: draggable handle on track. Value display: show current value above or beside. Min/max: configurable range limits. Step: snap to increment values. Dual thumb: range slider with two handles. Marks: optional tick marks at intervals. Keyboard: arrow keys to adjust value.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive slider/range input component. Track: horizontal bar (h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full), filled portion (bg-blue-500) up to thumb position. Thumb: circular handle (w-5 h-5 bg-white border-2 border-blue-500 rounded-full shadow), draggable, centered on track. Value display: show current value in tooltip above thumb (on hover/drag), or in label beside slider. Min/max/step: configurable range (min=0, max=100, step=1), value snaps to step increments. Disabled state: reduced opacity, no interaction. Dual thumbs (range): two handles for min-max range, filled area between, prevent thumbs crossing. Marks/ticks: optional tick marks at intervals, labels below (0, 25, 50, 75, 100), highlighted current value. Keyboard support: focus on thumb, left/right arrows adjust by step, Home/End jump to min/max, Page Up/Down for larger jumps. Mouse/touch: mousedown on thumb starts drag, mousemove updates, mouseup ends, touch events for mobile. Click on track: jump thumb to clicked position. Input binding: optional number input synced with slider value. Styling variants: different colors, sizes (sm, md, lg height), vertical orientation. Labels: min/max labels at ends, current value label. Format: custom value formatter (add %, $, units). Accessibility: role="slider", aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuetext for formatted display. Implementation: native input[type=range] with custom styling, or fully custom for more control. Libraries: @radix-ui/react-slider, rc-slider for complex needs.
